about: Models only the bench runs (DeviceEvalRunner.installedModels; BenchModels.kt). Never in setup, tiers, onboarding, the Model Catalog or the chat: none of them reads this file, and Catalog.parse drops a testOnly entry. The app never downloads these: copy the file over USB to Android/data/<package>/files/<filename> (adb push, any build) or files/<filename> (run-as, a debuggable build). Qwen3-0.6B: t9 0443 and 0452 (unsloth's Q4_K_M, the 1.7B's source and quant), the same shape as qwen3-1.7b-q4km in catalog.json without its answer tier.

models.label: Qwen3-0.6B (Q4_K_M)
models.description: 0.6B dense, thinking off. A bench test of a third tier for phones with less memory (t9 0443); not offered to users.
